events.comment: Cat_Boss: the The Cat fight. The Cat: a quick tabby with three lives. Swipes, pounces, zoomies, a dig-and-erupt from under the floor, a claw flurry and a heavy maul; each life is a phase. The scene links Player_Movement and Combat_Shared before this sheet. All of it is one script (a state machine of moves written as generators, see tools/bosses/kit.js); the numbers are variables on the Cat object.

inlineCode: // The Cat: generated by tools/bosses/build.js from tools/bosses/kit.js and tools/bosses/cat.js. Edit those and rebuild.
// The Cat: a quick tabby with three lives. Swipes, pounces, zoomies, a dig-and-erupt from under the floor, a claw flurry and a heavy maul; each life is a phase.
// Boss kit: the runtime both new bosses (the Cat and the Bladekeeper) are built on. tools/bosses/build.js joins this file, the
// boss's own script (cat.js, bladekeeper.js) and the generated animation table into one script event of that boss's sheet; the
// behaviour tests run the same text against stand-in objects.
//   1. reads what Combat_Shared flagged (JustPostureBroken, JustRecovered, JustLostLife, JustDied, JustStaggered, JustDodgedHit),
//      and applies the "hold" rules the Leaf Ranger has: HP running out without a posture break first kneels the boss for
//      StunDuration with the deathblow orb up (DeathHold on the last life, LifeHold with a life to spare);
//   2. routes the flags to the boss's reactions (stunned, recover, lifeLost, died, dodge, stagger), which interrupt whatever
//   3. runs the current move. A move is a generator: it `yield`s once per frame and uses kit.play / kit.wait / kit.glide /
//      kit.arc with `yield*`. When it ends the boss's director() picks the next one;
//   4. moves the boss's hitboxes and projectiles and removes the spent ones.
// The boss's animations are driven here, frame by frame (the sprite's own playback is paused), so a move knows exactly which
// frame a strike lands on and the animation can't drift out of step with its hitbox.
// Boss contract with Combat_Shared (see its header): the boss object is in the Enemy group with the usual variables (Health,
// Lives, Posture, ...), and everything that hurts the player is an EnemyHitbox object with Damage, HasHit and IsMelee.
const one = n => { const a = scene.getObjects(n); return a && a.length ? a[0] : null; };
const o = one(CFG.boss), V = o ? o.getVariables() : null;
const k = { scene, CFG, o, t: 0, dt: 1 / 60, facing: 1, state: "Intro", script: null, air: false, anim: "", frame: 0, hits: [], shots: [], fx: [], wasDead: false };
k.px = () => { const p = one("Player"); return p ? p.getCenterXInScene() : k.x; };
k.pv = n => { const p = one("Player"); return p ? p.getVariables().get(n) : null; };
k.pflag = n => { const v = k.pv(n); return !!v && v.getAsBoolean(); };
Object.defineProperty(k, "x", { get: () => o.getX(), set: x => o.setX(Math.max(CFG.minX, Math.min(CFG.maxX, x))) });
Object.defineProperty(k, "y", { get: () => o.getY(), set: y => o.setY(y) });
k.face = d => { if (d) { k.facing = d > 0 ? 1 : -1; o.flipX(k.facing < 0); } };
k.sfx = (file, vol, pitch) => { if (file) scene.getGame().getSoundManager().playSound(file, false, vol === undefined ? 70 : vol, pitch || 1); };
// CFG.anims[name] = { n: frames, dt: seconds per frame (a number, or a list per frame), loop }.
const A = n => { const a = CFG.anims[n]; if (!a) throw new Error("no animation " + n); return a; };
k.frameTime = (n, f) => { const a = A(n); return Array.isArray(a.dt) ? a.dt[f] : a.dt; };
k.duration = (n, from, to) => { const a = A(n); let s = 0; for (let f = from || 0; f <= (to === undefined ? a.n - 1 : to); f++) s += k.frameTime(n, f); return s; };
// Play an animation from frame `from` to `to`. opt.speed scales time; opt.on = { frame: fn } calls fn when that frame
// is first shown; opt.loops plays a looping animation that many times; opt.until() ends it early.
opt = opt || {}; const a = A(name), speed = opt.speed || 1, from = opt.from || 0, to = opt.to === undefined ? a.n - 1 : opt.to;
for (let l = 0; l < loops; l++) for (let f = from; f <= to; f++) {
if (f === to && l === loops - 1 && opt.noWaitLast) return;
while (left > 0) { yield; left -= k.dt; if (opt.until && opt.until()) return; }
k.wait = function* (s) { while (s > 0) { yield; s -= k.dt; } };
// Hold one frame of an animation for s seconds.
k.hold = function* (name, frame, s) { k.show(name, frame); yield* k.wait(s); };
// Move along the ground to x over dur seconds (eased); `during(u)` is called each frame with the progress 0 to 1 (to show a pose).
while (t < dur) { yield; t += k.dt; const u = Math.min(1, t / dur), e = ease === "out" ? 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u) : ease === "in" ? u * u : u; k.x = x0 + (toX - x0) * e; if (during) during(u); }
// A jump to x: a parabola `height` high over dur seconds. The feet leave and return to the floor at CFG.ground.
const x0 = k.x; let t = 0; k.air = true;
while (t < dur) { yield; t += k.dt; const u = Math.min(1, t / dur); k.x = x0 + (toX - x0) * u; k.y = CFG.ground - 4 * height * u * (1 - u); if (during) during(u); }
k.x = toX; k.y = CFG.ground; k.air = false;
// Walk toward x at speed px/s (animation looping), stopping within `stop` px of it or after `max` seconds.
k.walkTo = function* (getTarget, speed, anim, stop, max) {
const tx = getTarget(), d = tx - k.x;
k.face(d); k.x = k.x + Math.sign(d) * Math.min(Math.abs(d), speed * k.dt);
ft += k.dt; if (ft >= k.frameTime(anim, f)) { ft = 0; f = (f + 1) % a.n; }
// A hitbox follows the boss: dx is how far in front of him (in facing terms) the box starts, dy from his feet (up is
// negative). It lives for `life` seconds. Damage, HasHit and IsMelee are what Combat_Shared reads; kind, directional,
// shared (one deflect stops every box of the same kind) and posture are the optional extras the Samurai and Leaf Ranger use.
const h = scene.createObject(CFG.hitbox); if (!h) return null;
const rec = { o: h, dx: s.dx, dy: s.dy, w: s.w, h: s.h, born: k.t, life: s.life, follow: s.follow !== false, fixedX: null };
const left = r.fixedX !== null ? r.fixedX : (k.facing > 0 ? k.x + r.dx : k.x - r.dx - r.w);
k.dropHit = r => { const i = k.hits.indexOf(r); if (i >= 0) k.hits.splice(i, 1); r.o.deleteFromScene(scene); };
k.clearHits = () => { for (const r of k.hits.slice()) k.dropHit(r); };
// A projectile: a hitbox object of its own, flying by vx, vy (+gravity) from (x, y) until it hits the floor, the player
// or leaves the arena. anim names one of the projectile object's animations; onLand(shot) runs at the floor.
const p = scene.createObject(s.object || CFG.projectile); if (!p) return null;
const rec = Object.assign({ o: p, vx: 0, vy: 0, g: 0, born: k.t, life: 6, landed: 0 }, s);
k.clearShots = () => { for (const r of k.shots.slice()) { r.o.deleteFromScene(scene); } k.shots.length = 0; };
k.clearAll = () => { k.clearHits(); k.clearShots(); for (const f of k.fx.slice()) f.o.deleteFromScene(scene); k.fx.length = 0; };
// A visual only object (a mound, a trap), kept so the kit can clean it up when the fight ends.
k.spawnFx = (name, x, y) => { const f = scene.createObject(name); if (!f) return null; f.setPosition(x, y); const r = { o: f }; k.fx.push(r); return r; };
k.dropFx = r => { const i = k.fx.indexOf(r); if (i < 0) return; k.fx.splice(i, 1); r.o.deleteFromScene(scene); };
k.air = false; if (k.y !== CFG.ground) k.y = CFG.ground;
// Start one of the boss's moves now (debug keys, tests): it replaces whatever is running, and the director takes over after.
const m = AI.moves && AI.moves[name]; if (!m) return false;
k.interrupt((function* () { yield* m(); })(), name); return true;
const F = { broke: k.flag("JustPostureBroken"), recovered: k.flag("JustRecovered"), lost: k.flag("JustLostLife"), died: k.flag("JustDied"),
dodged: k.flag("JustDodgedHit"), staggered: k.flag("JustStaggered"), hit: k.flag("JustHitByPlayer"), hitPlayer: k.flag("JustHitPlayer"), deflected: k.flag("JustDeflected") };
// Holds. HP ran out on the last life with no posture break: kneel for StunDuration with the orb up, HP just above 0
// so the life is not taken, until a deathblow lands or the time runs out (then HP 0 and the death follows).
k.setFlag("JustDied", false); F.died = false; k.setFlag("JustLostLife", false); F.lost = false;
k.set("Lives", 1); k.set("Health", 0.01); k.set("Posture", k.num("MaxPosture")); k.setFlag("IsPostureBroken", true);
o.resetTimer("StunTimer"); k.setFlag("JustPostureBroken", true); F.broke = true; k.set("DeathHold", 1);
if (k.num("DeathHold") === 1 && F.recovered && !deathblow) { k.setFlag("JustRecovered", false); F.recovered = false; k.set("Health", 0); k.set("DeathHold", 2); }
// The same with a life to spare: he gets the life back and kneels at 0.01 HP, posture broken.
k.setFlag("JustLostLife", false); F.lost = false; k.set("Lives", k.num("Lives") + 1); k.set("Health", 0.01);
k.setFlag("JustPostureBroken", true); F.broke = true; k.set("LifeHold", 1); k.sfx("assets/Sfx/posture_broken.mp3", 80);
if (k.num("LifeHold") === 1 && F.recovered && !deathblow) { k.setFlag("JustRecovered", false); F.recovered = false; k.set("Health", 0); k.set("LifeHold", 2); }
// Reactions, most important first. Each replaces the running move.
// A kneeling boss during a hold can't be hurt by plain hits: only the deathblow (which sets HP directly) ends it.
for (const r of k.hits.slice()) { if (k.t - r.born >= r.life) k.dropHit(r); else if (r.follow) k.placeHit(r); }
if (r.landed) { r.landed -= k.dt; if (r.landed <= 0) { p.deleteFromScene(scene); k.shots.splice(k.shots.indexOf(r), 1); } continue; }
r.vy += (r.g || 0) * k.dt; p.setX(p.getX() + r.vx * k.dt); p.setY(p.getY() + r.vy * k.dt);
const out = p.getX() < -100 || p.getX() > 1400 || k.t - r.born > r.life;
if (r.floor !== undefined && p.getY() >= r.floor) { p.setY(r.floor); if (r.onLand) r.onLand(r); r.landed = r.landLife || 0.4; r.vx = r.vy = 0; p.getVariables().get("HasHit").setBoolean(true); }
// The enemy bars stay with him: Combat_Shared's fight UI lays them out; only their visibility is decided here.
// The Cat: a quick orange tabby with three lives. Its script, joined to tools/bosses/kit.js by tools/bosses/build.js.
// Everything tunable is a variable on the Cat object (listed in tools/bosses/cat.def.js), so a playtest can change it in the editor.
// Lives are its phases: with 3 left it stalks, swipes and pounces; with 2 it also digs under the floor and comes up beneath the
// player and spins a flurry of claws; with 1 it rears up for a heavy maul and its dashes come in threes. Each time a life goes
// (a deathblow, or its HP running out) it is knocked flat, and comes back from the ghost-cat halo with a hiss.
// How it fights fair: every attack has a held wind-up pose you can read, and every strike is a melee hitbox you can deflect
// (each deflect adds posture to it). The two things you can't deflect are the dash through you and the dig's eruption: roll them.
const lives = () => Math.round(k.num("Lives")), phase = () => 4 - Math.max(1, Math.min(3, lives())); // 1, 2, 3
const byPhase = (a, b, c) => (phase() === 1 ? a : phase() === 2 ? b : c);
const BODY = { dx: -70, w: 140, dy: -100, h: 100 };   // the cat's body, for moves where the body is the weapon
const cry = kind => { const l = k.CFG.sfx && k.CFG.sfx[kind]; if (l && l.length) k.sfxPick(l, kind === "hiss" ? 60 : 55); };
const bars = hide => { for (const n of ["Enemy_HP_Bar", "Enemy_Posture_Bar"]) for (const b of k.scene.getObjects(n)) b.hide(hide); };
let wantDodge = 0, dodgeCount = 0, dodgeEvery = 3, lastDodge = -99, rot = 0;
// Run to within `stop` px of the player (up to `max` s). The cat is fast: it is the player who has to read it.
function* chase(stop, max) { yield* k.walkTo(k.px, k.num("RunSpeed") * byPhase(1, 1.1, 1.25), "run", stop, max); }
function* prowl(max) { yield* k.walkTo(k.px, k.num("WalkSpeed"), "walk", 240, max); }
// One swipe: hold the wind-up pose (the telegraph), then the strike frames with a hitbox in front.
yield* k.play(anim, { from: 1, on: { 1: () => k.hitbox({ dmg: dmg("SwipeDamage"), dx: 10, w: reach || 110, dy, h, life: 0.16 }) } });
// Get a step closer between swipes so a combo keeps its reach.
function* lungeStep(px) { const to = k.x + k.facing * px; yield* k.glide(to, 0.1, "out"); }
// Swipes: a combo of 2 or 3 claws, the last one slower. A is high-high, B is low-low, C ends in the spinning double sweep.
const a = list[i], last = i === list.length - 1 && list.length > 2;
if (a === "atk5") { // The spin: claws out on both sides at once, so it is deflected like any other swing but cannot be dodged by stepping behind.
yield* k.play("atk5", { from: 1, on: { 1: () => k.hitbox({ dmg: dmg("SwipeDamage") + 4, dx: -110, w: 220, dy: -118, h: 112, life: 0.2, directional: 0 }) } });
} else yield* swing(a, i ? w * 0.7 : w, a === "atk3" || a === "atk4", 118);
// Pounce: creep toward the player (telegraph), crouch, then a leap that lands where the player stood. The cat is the weapon.
let t = 0; const creepTime = n ? 0.3 : byPhase(0.7, 0.55, 0.4), f = { i: 0, t: 0 };
while (t < creepTime) { // creeping: slinks toward the player, the tail low. The longer it creeps the nearer it comes.
yield; t += k.dt; f.t += k.dt; if (f.t >= 0.12) { f.t = 0; f.i = (f.i + 1) % 4; }
k.facePlayer(); if (Math.abs(k.px() - k.x) > 220) k.x = k.x + k.facing * 130 * k.dt; k.show("creep", f.i);
yield* k.hold("pounce", 0, 0.14); yield* k.hold("pounce", 1, byPhase(0.3, 0.25, 0.2)); // the crouch: nothing moves for a moment
const target = Math.max(k.CFG.minX, Math.min(k.CFG.maxX, k.px() + k.facing * -20)), dur = 0.5;
const box = k.hitbox(Object.assign({ dmg: dmg("PounceDamage"), life: dur + 0.1 }, BODY));
yield* k.arc(target, 190, dur, u => k.show("pounce", 2 + Math.min(3, Math.floor(u * 4))));
yield* k.hold("pounce", 7, byPhase(0.7, 0.55, 0.4)); // landed: a gap to punish
// The zoomies: a play bow (rear up, tail high: the tell), then a sprint through the player to the far wall and a skid.
// The body is the weapon, so it is best rolled through (a deflect timed at contact still works). In the last life it turns and comes back.
k.facePlayer(); const dir = k.facing, far = dir > 0 ? k.CFG.maxX : k.CFG.minX; cry("meow");
const box = k.hitbox(Object.assign({ dmg: dmg("DashDamage"), life: 2 }, BODY));
yield; k.x = k.x + dir * k.num("DashSpeed") * k.dt; ft += k.dt; if (ft >= 0.06) { ft = 0; f = (f + 1) % 5; } k.show("dash", f);
// Dig: the cat paws a hole and vanishes; a mound creeps under the player and, after a beat that shows it stopping, the cat
// erupts from it straight up. Roll out from over the mound (a deflect at the eruption works too). (Life 2 and 1.)
const m = k.spawnFx("Cat_Mound", k.x, k.CFG.ground); if (m) { mounds.push(m); m.o.setAnimationName("Rise"); m.o.setAnimationFrame(0); m.o.pauseAnimation(); }
let x = k.x, t = 0; const follow = byPhase(1.5, 1.4, 1.1), freeze = 0.55;
yield; t += k.dt; const going = t < follow;
if (going) { const d = k.px() - x; x += Math.sign(d) * Math.min(Math.abs(d), k.num("MoundSpeed") * k.dt); }

if (m) { m.o.setPosition(x, k.CFG.ground); const shake = going ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 90) * 3; m.o.setX(x + shake); m.o.setAnimationFrame(going ? (Math.floor(t * 8) % 2) : 2 + (Math.floor(t * 20) % 2)); }
k.hitbox({ dmg: dmg("BurrowDamage"), dx: 0, w: 130, dy: -290, h: 290, life: 0.32, follow: false, x: k.x - 65, directional: 0 });
yield* k.arc(k.x, 230, 0.55, u => k.show(u < 0.5 ? "jumpUp" : "jumpDown", Math.min(3, Math.floor((u < 0.5 ? u * 2 : (u - 0.5) * 2) * 4))));
// Claw flurry: rears up, then three spinning swipes on both sides. One deflect stops all of them (shared).
yield* k.play("rear", { to: 4, speed: 0.8 });      // rising on the hind legs
k.hitbox({ dmg: dmg("ScratchDamage"), dx: -140, w: 280, dy: -190, h: 190, life: 0.2, directional: 0, shared: true });
yield* k.play("rear", { from: 11, to: 15, speed: 1 }); // dropping back down
// Maul (last life): rises high on its hind legs, roaring (a long, readable tell), then slams down in front of it.
yield* k.play("rear", { to: 7, speed: 0.55 });     // up, up, up
k.hitbox({ dmg: dmg("MaulDamage"), dx: 0, w: 250, dy: -210, h: 210, life: 0.22 });
yield* k.hold("rear", 13, byPhase(1, 1, 0.9));      // the slam leaves it open
// A hiss that shakes the player's timing: the fur goes up and the cat waits a random beat before the next move.
function* hissFeint() { k.setState("Hiss"); k.facePlayer(); cry("hiss"); yield* k.play("aggress"); yield* k.wait(k.rand(0.1, 0.45)); }
// Back-flip away from a swing it dodged (a free, safe hop; the player's swing hit nothing).
k.invuln(true); k.setFlag("WillDodgeHit", false); lastDodge = k.t; k.facePlayer();
const to = Math.max(k.CFG.minX, Math.min(k.CFG.maxX, k.x - k.facing * 300));
yield* k.arc(to, 150, 0.45, u => k.show(u < 0.5 ? "jumpUp" : "jumpDown", Math.min(3, Math.floor((u < 0.5 ? u * 2 : (u - 0.5) * 2) * 4))));
function* stagger() { k.clearHits(); yield* k.play("hurt"); yield* k.wait(0.15); }
for (const m of mounds) k.dropFx(m); k.o.hide(false);
function* recover() { yield* k.play("sitUp"); yield* k.hold("idle", 0, 0.25); }
// A life is gone: knocked flat, a beat on the floor, then back from the ghost halo somewhere else, with a hiss.
function* idle() { k.clearHits(); k.face(k.facing); while (true) { yield* k.play("idle"); } }
k.facePlayer(); yield* k.play("eat", { loops: 2, speed: 0.9 }); // busy with its supper...
// A fixed rotation per life, with the player's distance deciding the opening when he stands right on it.
const list = ROT[phase()]; let pick = list[rot++ % list.length];
if (k.dist() < 150 && pick === "prowl") pick = "A"; // crowded: claw first
if (pick === "prowl") { k.setState("Stalk"); yield* prowl(1.6); pick = k.dist() < 300 ? "A" : "pounce"; }
// Every move by name, for the debug keys and the tests (kit.force).

const moves = { swipeA: () => swipes("A"), swipeB: () => swipes("B"), swipeC: () => swipes("C"), pounce: () => pounce(phase() === 3 ? 2 : 1), zoom: zoomies, burrow, flurry, maul, hiss: hissFeint, dodge, stagger, lifeLost };
director, idle, died, lifeLost, stunned, recover, stagger, dodge, moves,
cleanup() { for (const m of mounds.splice(0)) k.dropFx(m); k.o.hide(false); k.o.setOpacity && k.o.setOpacity(255); },
// Dodge decision, the Leaf Ranger's way: every DodgeEvery-th swing near it (2 to 4, re-rolled after each dodge) is dodged,
// so a player can't count it out. The dodge itself happens when Combat_Shared flags that swing as dodged.
if (k.pflag("AttackPressed") && k.dist() < 230 && (k.state === "Neutral" || k.state === "Stalk") && !k.flag("WillDodgeHit") && !k.flag("Invulnerable") && k.t - lastDodge >= k.num("DodgeCooldown")) {
if (dodgeCount >= dodgeEvery) { k.setFlag("WillDodgeHit", true); dodgeCount = 0; dodgeEvery = Math.floor(k.rand(2, 5)); wantDodge = k.t; }
if (k.flag("WillDodgeHit") && k.t - wantDodge > 1.2 && k.state !== "Dodge") k.setFlag("WillDodgeHit", false);
const kit = runtimeScene.__bossKit || (runtimeScene.__bossKit = makeKit(runtimeScene, CFG, catAI));
// Debug keys (the DEBUG_KEYS switch in Combat_Shared turns them off with the rest): each starts one of the moves at once; Numpad0 takes a life (HP to 0).
if (input) for (const key in KEYS) if (input.wasKeyJustPressed(runtimeScene, key)) { if (KEYS[key] === "loseLife") kit.set("Health", 0); else kit.force(KEYS[key]); }
